identity: Obviously we've been running experiments with L61, as we've designated her, and her abilities aren't as strong as they seem to have been in those moments after the incident.  She can't knock full-grown humans off their feet anymore but she can pick up a pencil and hold it steady, in the air, in complete defiance of gravity and everything we thought we understood about physics and, frankly, how the universe works at all.  Portals at least have rules they follow, but what is this?
